chunks: The fastest good in reward is righteousness.

key_terms.الْبِرُّ: righteousness; moral goodness and dutiful virtue
key_terms.الْخَيْرِ: goodness; virtuous action in a general sense
key_terms.ثَوَابًا: reward; recompense granted by Allah for good deeds

ai.seo_question: Which good deed is the quickest to receive reward from Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that among good deeds, birr is especially swift in bringing reward. It highlights the great moral value of righteousness and its immediate spiritual consequence with Allah.
